children: Thailand posted a USD 5.86 billion trade deficit in September 2026, shifting from a USD 1.28 billion surplus a year earlier, marking a 12th straight monthly shortfall and worse than market forecasts of a USD 1.8 billion deficit.
It was the largest trade gap since June, as imports rose more than exports.

Imports surged 50.40% yoy, accelerating sharply from a 25.1% rise in August and surpassing forecasts of 31.3%, supported by ongoing government stimulus measures aimed at boosting consumption and investment.
Meanwhile, exports rose 24.0% yoy, easing slightly from a 24.3% increase in August but far exceeding estimates of 17.9%.

title: Thailand Trade Gap Largest in 3 Months
